node.title: Re^2: -T changed behavior
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I think you might be right about that entry in [doc://perl5220delta#Selected-Bug-Fixes|perl5220delta]. Just for reference, I think that the corresponding commit is [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/commitdiff/f13c8ddbfb6aa3d08ad6f1ea2a66babf3f782cac|f13c8ddbf], which references [https://www.nntp.perl.org/group/perl.perl5.porters/2014/05/msg214950.html|this P5P thread].

Of course, we really need [tothestars] to show a [id://1177642|SSCCE], then it'd even be possible to run a git blame to narrow it down to the exact commit. But using the above information, it might be something related to misdetection of UTF-8.

[tothestars]: Note that [doc://-X|-T] is a heuristic test only, for example, the documentation has always said (emphasis mine): "The first block or so of the file is examined". If you want any kind of certainty, you should use a more reliable method - what's best here depends on what you're trying to achieve with this test.
